name: Real vs AI Art Research
note: Klasifikasi Citra Seni Asli vs AI (CNN Baseline vs Transfer Learning)

children.name: Step -1: Pre-Project & Docs
children.note: Audit proposal awal, perumusan RQ1-RQ4, setup Google Drive & Living Research Log

children.name: Audit proposal & 5 celah teknis
children.note: Identifikasi normalisasi backbone, ledakan parameter Flatten 25.7M, repo rujukan ResNet50, shortcut learning, & estimasi waktu.

children.name: Rumuskan Research Questions (RQ1-RQ4)
children.note: Scratch vs TL, Frozen vs Fine-Tuning, Shortcut vs Real Features, OOD Generalization.

children.name: Buat struktur folder Google Drive
children.note: Folder Real-vs-AI-Art-Classification (01_Docs_&_Logs, 02_Notebooks, 03_Figures_&_Visuals, 04_Models).

children.name: Inisialisasi Living Research Log (GDocs)
children.note: Buat Google Docs Research Log & Progress Tracker sebagai catatan progres berkelanjutan.

children.name: Phase 0: Setup & Reproducibility
children.note: Setup direktori kerja lokal, Python 3.12 via uv, seed locking, dan experiment log CSV

children.name: Setup direktori kerja & Python 3.12
children.note: Buat data/, notebooks/, src/, models/, reports/figures/, experiments/ dan .venv Python 3.12 (TF 2.21.0).

children.name: Kunci random seed (42) di src/config.py
children.note: Lock PYTHONHASHSEED, random, numpy, dan tf.keras.utils.set_random_seed(42).

children.name: Siapkan experiments/experiment_log.csv
children.note: Template pencatatan hyperparameter, metrik evaluasi, waktu/epoch, dan baris patokan Ref-0.

children.name: Tetapkan konvensi label (0=Real, 1=AI)
children.note: LABEL_MAP = {0: 'Real Art', 1: 'AI-Generated Art'} terpusat di src/config.py.

children.name: Phase 1: Data Forensics & Pipeline
children.note: Audit integritas dataset, deteksi bias/shortcut, deduplikasi pHash, split 80/10/10, tf.data pipeline

children.name: Unduh dataset HF & audit integritas
children.note: Unduh DataScienceProject/Art_Images_Ai_And_Real_, cek jumlah aktual, file korup, dan konversi ke RGB 3-channel.

children.name: Forensik bias (resolusi, aspect ratio, format)
children.note: Plot distribusi resolusi, rasio aspek, JPG vs PNG, dan ukuran file per kelas untuk mendeteksi potensi shortcut learning.

children.name: Deduplikasi perceptual hash (pHash)
children.note: Hapus gambar duplikat atau near-duplicate menggunakan imagehash sebelum data splitting agar bebas leakage.

children.name: Stratified split 80/10/10 & kunci Test set
children.note: Simpan daftar path dan label ke data/processed/splits.csv agar semua model memakai split yang identik.

children.name: Bangun tf.data pipeline & augmentasi
children.note: Resize 224x224, batch(32), cache(), prefetch(AUTOTUNE), serta RandomFlip/Rotation/Zoom khusus Train set.

children.name: Tanamkan preprocess_input per backbone
children.note: Masukkan Rescaling(1./255), mobilenet_v2.preprocess_input, atau resnet50.preprocess_input sebagai layer pertama model.

children.name: Phase 2: Controlled Baseline (Scratch)
children.note: Replikasi benchmark naive (~77%) vs pembangunan fair baseline CNN 4-blok dengan GAP

children.name: Exp-1A: Naive CNN (2 Conv + Flatten)
children.note: Replikasi arsitektur rujukan (32, 64 filter + Flatten + Dense 128) dan buktikan ledakan ~25.7M parameter serta overfitting.

children.name: Exp-1B: Proper Scratch CNN (4 Conv + GAP)
children.note: Fair baseline 4 blok Conv2D (32->64->128->256) + BatchNorm + MaxPool + GlobalAveragePooling2D + Dropout(0.4).

children.name: Pasang callbacks standar training
children.note: EarlyStopping (patience 6), ReduceLROnPlateau (factor 0.5, patience 3), dan ModelCheckpoint (save_best_only).

children.name: Catat metrik & learning curves baseline
children.note: Simpan val metrics, waktu/epoch, jumlah parameter, dan plot kurva train vs val ke experiment_log.csv.

children.name: Phase 3: Transfer Learning & Ablation
children.note: Eksperimen terkontrol Frozen Feature Extractor vs Selective Fine-Tuning pada MobileNetV2 & ResNet50

children.name: Stage 1: Frozen Backbone (MobileNetV2 & ResNet50)
children.note: Latih head identik (GAP -> Dropout 0.3 -> Dense 128 -> Dropout 0.2 -> Sigmoid) dengan Adam lr=3e-4. Exp-2A MobileNetV2 Frozen: 94.33% acc / 0.9909 AUC; Exp-3A ResNet50 Frozen: 97.87% acc / 0.9983 AUC.

children.name: Stage 2: Selective Fine-Tuning (BN frozen)
children.note: Unfreeze 20-30% layer akhir backbone, jaga semua BatchNormalization tetap trainable=False, AdamW lr=1e-5. Exp-2B MobileNetV2 FT: 97.52% acc / 0.9975 AUC / 24.65 MB; Exp-3B ResNet50 FT: 98.23% acc / 0.9989 AUC / 224.75 MB.

children.name: (Opsional) Pembanding EfficientNetV2B0 / ConvNeXt
children.note: Uji 1 arsitektur CNN modern pada split dan pipeline yang sama untuk mengukur batas atas akurasi.

children.name: Phase 4: Deep Evaluation & Explainability
children.note: Threshold tuning, evaluasi Test set final, Error Analysis, Grad-CAM, dan OOD Stress Test

children.name: Threshold tuning pada Validation set
children.note: Analisis kurva Precision-Recall di Val set untuk menentukan threshold optimal (kunci Recall >= 80% / F1 max).

children.name: Evaluasi final Test set (Acc, F1, ROC-AUC, CM)
children.note: Evaluasi sekali saja pada Test set: Accuracy, Loss, Precision, Recall, F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Confusion Matrix.

children.name: Ukur efisiensi inference (ms, params, MB)
children.note: Benchmark rata-rata latensi per gambar, total parameter, dan ukuran file .keras tiap model.

children.name: Error Analysis visual (10-16 sampel FP & FN)
children.note: Inspeksi gambar salah prediksi beserta confidence score untuk memetakan gaya seni yang paling mengecoh model.

children.name: Implementasi & verifikasi Grad-CAM
children.note: Visualisasikan heatmap layer konvolusi terakhir untuk memastikan model fokus ke tekstur karya, bukan background.

children.name: OOD Stress Test (20-30 citra luar dataset)
children.note: Uji model terbaik ke lukisan museum/WikiArt dan generator AI modern (Midjourney v6, Flux, DALL-E 3).

children.name: Phase 5: Packaging, Demo & Write-Up
children.note: Ekspor model final, antarmuka demo Gradio + Grad-CAM, dan laporan teknis akhir

children.name: Ekspor model terbaik .keras (self-contained)
children.note: Simpan file .keras final yang menerima input mentah [0..255] dengan preprocessing tertanam di dalamnya.

children.name: Bangun demo interaktif Gradio + Grad-CAM
children.note: UI upload gambar -> label prediksi + confidence score + heatmap Grad-CAM berdampingan.

children.name: Finalisasi laporan portofolio & future work
children.note: Lengkapi README.md & Research Log dengan tabel ablasi, temuan forensik, OOD test, dan limitasi (FFT/ELA).
